# ai-release-notes · Release v0.5.0

_prod · July 28, 2026 · Changes since v0.4.0_

---

You can now ask questions about your release notes and revise the notes and their indexes.

### 🚀 New Features

- Added an assistant for asking questions about existing release notes and revising selected notes or indexes.

### ✨ Improvements

- Moved the default configuration location to the ".ai-release-notes/" folder.
